shortDescription: DSH local long-term memory: search, read, propose and approve
longDescription: Connects to the DSH local memory store (~/.dsh/memory/, Markdown, maintained by DSH). Provides read-only search (memory_search / memory_read / memory_list_pending) and tiered writes: Tier A direct write (memory_write, limited to adding facts/projects and appending journal, with sensitive-content interception and audit); Tier B proposal approval (memory_propose / memory_approve / memory_reject, approval only responds to explicit in-session user instructions). Data stays on this machine, no network access.

dsh-memory.description: DSH local long-term memory: search, read, propose and approve.

tryPrompts: Read the memory index.md and tell me the latest project status
Search my memory for entries about the memory store
List this month's pending memory proposals

dsh-memory.description: DSH local long-term memory: tiered search, read-only reads, proposal approval (data stays local, no network).
